name: gizza-ai/regression-model-trainer
summary: Train linear, ridge, or small random-forest regressions from a pasted numeric table.

tool.description: Fit a regression model to a pasted numeric table, predict a target column, and report R², RMSE, MAE, coefficients or feature importance, optional test split, and optional cross-validation. Runs locally in pure Rust/WASM.

alpha.description: Ridge L2 penalty strength. Used only when model is ridge.

cv_folds.description: Cross-validation folds: 0 disables CV, otherwise use 2 through 10.

data.description: CSV, TSV, semicolon, pipe, or whitespace-delimited numeric table. Use one row per observation; the first row may be a header.

decimals.description: Decimal places for text and CSV output.

features.description: Optional comma-separated feature columns by name or 1-based index. Leave empty to use every non-target column.

header.description: Whether the first row contains column names.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for each random_forest tree.

model.description: Regression algorithm: ordinary least squares, L2-regularized ridge, or a deterministic small random forest.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for splits, folds, and random forest sampling.

standardize.description: Standardize predictors before applying ridge regularization, then report coefficients back in original units.

target.description: Target column to predict: last, first, a 1-based index, or a header name.

test_split.description: Fraction of rows to hold out for a deterministic test set, from 0 to 0.5.
